top_liked.author: @mattirealm
top_liked.text: Sounds like cognitive behavioral therapy later on in your talk. I was going to say, thank you for bringing it up!  I do actually think it is the most effective type of therapy. And the glasses look badass dude!

top_liked.author: @KariAnneAKA-God
top_liked.text: I keep almost everything at an assumption, but I only try to define what I have evidence for. It is in the realm of striving for the best, but knowing the worst still may yet be the result, so I try to be prepared for that. Seeing things in an assumed position, allows me to test…
